readAt: YYYY-MM-DD (the date you read the schedule)

cards.name: Residential schedule with net metering
cards.status: template (change to "in force" once every value below is filled in)
cards.effective: the date the schedule took effect, as the schedule states it

accessUsdMonth.cite: the schedule's section for the customer (access) charge

deliveryUsdKwh.cite: the schedule's section for the energy delivery charge

demandUsdKw.cite: the schedule's section for the demand charge (0 if it has none)

supplySummerUsdKwh.cite: the schedule's section for the supply charge in the summer months

supplyWinterUsdKwh.cite: the schedule's section for the supply charge in the other months

demandWindow.cite: the schedule's definition of billing demand (the hours it is measured in)

pca.cite: the schedule's power cost adjustment, if it has one (its monthly value is typed from your bills)

rules: each net metering rule, with its section
